headline: Russia accuses Estonia of hostile actions that are "about to trigger an open war"
summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry accused NATO and EU member Estonia of hostile actions that are close to triggering open war. The accusation followed Estonia's announcement that it was closing its land border.
why: Estonia borders Russia and is a NATO and EU member, so tensions on that frontier affect regional security, trade routes and defence spending.
original_headline: Rusia acusa a Estonia de acciones hostiles que están "a punto de desencadenar una guerra abierta"
